fact: Agence Togo Digital publishes online the structuring elements of the Architecture d'Entreprise Gouvernementale du Togo (AEGT): a vision, twelve orientation statements and governance, general, business and functional principles for the state information system; the page carries no publication date, so the 2026-09-04 retrieval date stands as a ceiling.

The Ministry of Finance and Budget says budget data entry is currently done in SIGFiP and in parallel in SOLAF, with 236 regional agents trained in SOLAF on commitment, settlement, ordering and payment mandates in August-September 2024.

Togo's finance ministry refers to the existing budget information system SIGFiP in which budget execution runs, and an EU-IMF workshop of 25-27 February 2026 specified computerising commitment plans and annual work plans within it.
